content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the vilnius city district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property the applicant was awarded ownership of an apartment a nonresidential premises with a parking lot and a car owned by a limited company the defendant was awarded ownership of a portion of the nonresidential premises with a parking lot and was ordered to give the applicant their car the defendant was also ordered to pay the applicant compensation for their share of the defendants property the court referred to several articles related to property in a matrimonial context including shareable property shares of matrimonial property establishment of an asset balance joint matrimonial property and personal property of the spouses the court received a claim from the applicant requesting the dissolution of the marriage due to the defendants fault the court ordered the defendant to pay nonpecuniary damages and divide the property between the parties the court considered the parties conflictual relationship and the applicants state of health in making these decisions the court also addressed the costs of the proceedings with the party in whose favor the judgment was rendered being responsible for paying the costs the court supported the request to dissolve the marriage and ordered the defendant to pay stamp duty and other costs
